display.purpose: The FLOWSPACE wordmark only; 8.4vw with 0.28em tracking at 720px and below.

title.purpose: The email address, the primary action.

label.purpose: Uppercase top rail and social links; 0.14em tracking on small screens.

label-wide.purpose: Uppercase status line beneath the wordmark.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: dawn
motion.purpose: The light blade fades in once on load.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: opacity 0 and blur(6px) to rest, 2.4s, 0.4s / 0.9s delay
motion.purpose: Wordmark then status settle out of blur once.

motion.name: light-drift
motion.value: --x = 62% + sin(t/14s) * 10% + pointer lean up to 3% (lerp 0.03 per frame)
motion.purpose: Slow drift of the light blade; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Email Link
components.description: The primary action: the studio email with a withdrawing underline.
components.css: .ds-email { color: #E8E7E3; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(15px, 1.2vw, 18px); font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 6px; background: linear-gradient(#E8E7E3, #E8E7E3) left bottom / 100% 1px no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), letter-spacing 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-email:hover, .ds-email:focus-visible { letter-spacing: 0.06em; background-size: 0% 1px; background-position: right bottom; } .ds-email:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #E8E7E3; outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Social Links
components.description: Tracked caps links in Dusk Grey that rise to Paper White on hover.
components.css: .ds-social { display: flex; gap: 28px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8E8D88; } .ds-social a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-social a:hover { color: #E8E7E3; } .ds-social a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #E8E7E3; outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Top Rail
components.description: Meta rail: practice left, location right, in tracked caps.

components.css: .ds-room { position: relative; height: 240px; overflow: hidden; background: #0D0D0C; } .ds-slot { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 22%; left: 62%; width: clamp(90px, 11vw, 180px); transform: translateX(-50%) skewX(-8deg); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(236, 233, 226, 0.10) 0%, rgba(236, 233, 226, 0.05) 55%, rgba(236, 233, 226, 0) 100%); filter: blur(18px); } .ds-floor { position: absolute; bottom: 0; height: 22%; left: 62%; width: clamp(260px, 30vw, 520px); transform: translateX(-36%) skewX(-38deg); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(236, 233, 226, 0.07) 0%, rgba(236, 233, 226, 0.02) 100%); border-top: 1px solid rgba(236, 233, 226, 0.16); filter: blur(6px); }

narrative.northStar: The Dark Room With One Window
narrative.overview:
Flowspace is presented as an unlit room. The ground is a warm near-black, the type is thin and quiet, and the only event in the space is a soft blade of daylight falling through an unseen slot window onto the floor. With no photography or portfolio to show, light itself stands in for architecture: the page is about proportion, restraint and one carefully placed source of illumination.

Density is minimal. One full-height viewport holds three bands: a top rail of small spaced caps, a centred stage with the wordmark and a single line of status, and a bottom rail sitting above one hairline. Everything is achromatic and warm-neutral; the email address is the only element drawn at full text brightness outside the wordmark, because writing to the studio is the only action.

Motion is slow and atmospheric, never decorative. The light fades in like dawn, the wordmark and status settle out of blur once, and the light blade drifts across the room on a long sine sweep while leaning gently toward the pointer. All of it stops under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black ground with warm off-white and muted grey type; no hue.
Archivo only, weights 200 to 400, the wordmark in the widest cut (wdth 125).
Generous letter-spacing on every uppercase line, optically balanced when centred.
One 1px hairline rule as the only drawn line.
One light effect: a translucent, blurred, skewed blade of daylight.
Square, unbordered, unshadowed; nothing is a card.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: The daylight blade is the world's single light effect. Translucent gradients and blur belong to it and to nothing else on the page; no other element glows, tints or blurs at rest.

rules.name: The Bright-Means-Act Rule
rules.body: Outside the wordmark, only the actionable thing (the email, and a social link on hover) is drawn in Paper White. Everything informational stays in Dusk Grey.

rules.name: The Thin Voice Rule
rules.body: Weights stay between 200 and 400. Nothing on the page is bold; emphasis comes from size, width and brightness.

rules.name: The Balanced Tracking Rule
rules.body: Any centred tracked line carries a negative right margin equal to its letter-spacing (-0.42em on the wordmark, -0.5em on the status), so the trailing space does not push it off centre.

rules.name: The Light-Is-Depth Rule
rules.body: The only sense of volume on the page comes from the daylight falling into the room. Surfaces never lift.

dos: Do keep the ground Unlit Room edge to edge and let content sit directly on it.
Do keep type in Archivo between weights 200 and 400, using the wdth axis for the wordmark.
Do track uppercase lines generously (0.24em for labels, 0.5em for status) and balance centred tracking with a matching negative right margin.
Do reserve Paper White for the wordmark and the actionable element.
Do use the standard ease (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and long, slow durations (0.3s to 3.2s); remove all of it under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use the daylight blade, with its translucent gradients and blur, as the single light effect.
donts: Don't add a second light, glow, tint or blur; the One Light Rule allows exactly one.
Don't add shadows, cards, rounded corners or borders beyond the single hairline rule.
Don't introduce hue; the palette is warm achromatic.
Don't use bold weights or a second typeface.
Don't set small caps labels above headings as kickers; tracked caps live in the rails and the status line only.
Don't use the Hairline grey or Daylight for text.
